findings.description: labels(record) returns the original list from record, which means callers can modify the returned list and inadvertently modify record['labels'], breaking the contract that the returned list must be separate.
findings.evidence: labels({'labels': ['a', 'b']}) returns a reference; mutating that list changes the original record.

review.summary: Candidate returns the original labels list instead of a copy, so modifications to the result mutate the input record, violating the contract.
